name: Canvas of Lost Love
source:
In the gothic city of Ravenspire, you are a gifted artist with the power to blur the line between reality and the ethereal—bringing your paintings to life. But your extraordinary talent is shackled under the control of Damien Blackwood, a ruthless art collector who keeps you impoverished and trapped. Everything changes when one of your creations, Luca, a living painting, awakens—bringing a new world of passion, mystery, and danger.

As your bond with Luca deepens, you discover his existence is far more complicated than you ever imagined. But Luca isn’t the only one vying for your heart. Julien, a reformed thief with a dark past, and Damien, the possessive curator who sees you as his to control, both ignite forbidden desires within you.

Love, power, and danger intertwine as you navigate Ravenspire’s treacherous art scene. Will you break free from Damien’s oppressive grip, or succumb to his dark obsession? The choice is yours—explore a world of twisted romance, supernatural intrigue, and dangerous art.

Unravel your destiny, fall in love, and create your masterpiece.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.canvasotome]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在哥特式城市乌鸦尖塔，你是一位才华横溢的艺术家，有能力模糊现实与空灵之间的界限，让你的画作栩栩如生。但你非凡的才华却被达米安·布莱克伍德（Damien Blackwood）的控制所束缚，他是一位无情的艺术收藏家，让你陷入贫困和困境。当你的创作之一卢卡（一幅活生生的画作）苏醒时，一切都会改变——带来一个充满激情、神秘和危险的新世界。

随着你与卢卡的联系加深，你发现他的存在远比你想象的复杂。但卢卡并不是唯一一个争夺你心的人。朱利安（Julien），一个有着黑暗过去的改过自新的小偷，和达米安（Damien），一个占有欲极强的馆长，将你视为他的控制者，两人都点燃了你内心被禁止的欲望。

当你在鸦塔危险的艺术场景中穿行时，爱情、权力和危险交织在一起。你会摆脱达米安的压迫，还是屈服于他黑暗的痴迷？选择权在你——探索一个充满扭曲浪漫、超自然阴谋和危险艺术的世界。

解开你的命运，坠入爱河，创造你的杰作。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.canvasotome]Google Play[/url]]
